article.title: Variación en preposiciones y expresiones de fecha
article.part: Registro, variación y norma — Register, variation, and standard usage
article.chapter: Variedades del inglés — Varieties of English

claims.summary: Regional varieties of English differ in conventional temporal prepositions, notably British at the weekend alongside American on the weekend. Written English date conventions also often differ: American month–day order versus British day–month order. These patterns are matters of regional usage, not an inherent difference in the time being referenced.

links.notes: Registered grammar reference used for British/American temporal prepositional variation and general date-expression conventions.
